facts.title: spinach and chickpeas
ingredients: 1/2 pound (230 grams) dried chickpeas, cooked until soft and tender* or two 15-ounce cans of chickpeas, drained and rinsed
A hefty 1-inch slice from a country loaf or about 2 slices from sandwich loaf bread (2.5 ounces or 75 grams), crusts removed and cut into small cubes
Salt and freshly ground black pepper
facts.author: Deb Perelman
